rationale: v2 now requires prospective studies with clinical outcomes as the endpoint; retrospective analyses and change-in-management studies, previously acceptable as supporting evidence, are no longer sufficient.
v2 explicitly permits repeat testing on documented progression, a new primary, or to assess resistance — broader than v1's prohibition on prior testing.
v2 adds a definition of 'metastatic' (spread beyond regional lymph nodes) without changing the underlying coverage bar.
